title: Company Structure
completion_message: ¡Magnífico! Ahora conoces la estructura corporativa de una empresa en inglés.

parts.visual: The Board of Directors (Junta Directiva) lidera la empresa. The CEO (Director Ejecutivo) reporta a la junta. The Headquarters (Sede Central) es la oficina principal.
parts.audio: The Board of Directors leads the company. The CEO reports to the board. The Headquarters is the main office.

parts.visual: Subsidiaries (Subsidiarias/Filiales): Empresas más pequeñas que pertenecen a la empresa matriz (Parent company). Branches (Sucursales): Diferentes oficinas locales o tiendas de la misma empresa. Departments (Departamentos): HR, IT, R&D (Research and Development / Investigación y Desarrollo).
parts.audio: Subsidiaries are smaller companies owned by the parent company. Branches are local offices or stores of the same company. Departments include HR, IT, and R&D, which stands for Research and Development.

stages.title: Interactive Quiz
stages.description: Elige la palabra de estructura corporativa correcta.

questions.question: The ____ of Directors makes the biggest decisions. (Junta directiva).
Our ____ are in New York. (Oficinas centrales/Sede).
The company has 50 ____ around the country. (Sucursales).
Instagram is a ____ of Meta. (Subsidiaria/Filial).
Meta is the ____ company of Instagram. (Empresa matriz).
The CEO reports directly to the ____. (Junta).
questions.explanation: El CEO le reporta a The Board (la junta).

questions.question: The ____ department creates new products. (Investigación y Desarrollo).
Our company is ____ into five departments. (Dividida).
Who is the ____ of the IT department? (Cabeza/Jefe principal).
questions.explanation: Head of department = jefe/director del departamento.

questions.question: We opened a new ____ in London. (Sucursal).
The ____ company controls the subsidiaries. (Matriz).
Research and ____ (R&D) is crucial for tech companies. (Desarrollo).
I work at the ____ in Seattle. (Sede central).
questions.explanation: Headquarters siempre lleva 's' al final, incluso en singular.

questions.question: A ____ is a completely separate legal entity owned by another company.
The Board of ____ meets every month.
The company ____ (estructura) is very traditional.
We have three main ____ (divisiones) in the company.
I report to the ____ of Sales. (Director/Jefe).
questions.explanation: Head of Sales = Director/Jefe de ventas.

questions.question: The ____ consists of 10 members. (Junta).
A local bank office is usually called a ____.
